findings.evidence: NEW finding — raw i18n keys leak into aria-label DOM attributes (screen-reader surface). KDS states 01/04/05/07/09 each carry 4× <button ... aria-expanded="false" aria-label="label.kds_toggle_items">…</button> on the per-card chevron. The B-002 run-2 fix (added aria-expanded for screen readers) hardcoded the literal string 'label.kds_toggle_items' instead of routing it through t(). POS states 01/02/03 carry <button ... aria-label="button.menu">…</button> on the burger-menu icon (legacy — was reported as console warning in run-1 B-005, the console warning is now silenced because Vue-i18n's missing-key console handler was muted, but the underlying raw key still leaks to the accessibility tree). Visible to screen-reader users today; visible as raw text to any user whose locale lacks fr fallback. Cat 1 (i18n leak) via accessibility surface.
findings.fix_hint: (1) KDS card toggle: replace the literal 'label.kds_toggle_items' with t('label.kds_toggle_items') (or :aria-label="$t('label.kds_toggle_items')" in the template) AND add the key to lang/fr.json + lang/en.json + lang/ar.json. (2) POS header burger: same fix for 'button.menu' — add to translation files and bind via t(). (3) Add an audit-grade Playwright assertion: page.evaluate() over $$('[aria-label]') and fail if any aria-label matches /^[a-z]+(\.[a-z_]+)+$/. This catches future regressions of the same shape.

convergence_verdict: PARTIAL CONVERGENCE — run-3 closed B-003 cleanly (the loop-blocking P1 from run-2). P0 remains 0 for the 2nd consecutive run. However, three findings are now in their 3rd consecutive heal cycle (B-004 AUDIT orphans, B-007 icon-only Prêt, B-009 cart-resets-to-zero) — per CLAUDE.md §8 healing rule (max 3 consecutive heals), these MUST be either fixed in the next cycle or formally escalated to human gate. A NEW P1 (B-010) was uncovered: run-2's B-002 fix introduced a hardcoded i18n key in an aria-label, and the legacy 'button.menu' aria-label leak that run-1's console-warning fix did not address is now visible at the DOM-attribute layer. Net delta vs run-2: P1 stayed at 1 (B-003 closed, B-010 opened), P2 stayed at 3 (same three never-fixed P2s). Wave B is GREEN on the loop-blocking P0 gate but NOT yet converged on the P1 gate. Recommend: (a) one final heal cycle to land aria-label translations, AUDIT cleanup, Prêt button accessibility, and cart reset deferral, (b) if any of B-004 / B-007 / B-009 reappear in run-4, escalate to human review per CLAUDE.md §8 — that would be 4 consecutive heals on the same defect family.
